svg.aria-label: A terminal: atlas check prints, once a day, that from Atlas 0.70 the command is atlas-code, what needs the new name, and the alias that keeps the short one, before its own output

g.text: Note: from Atlas 0.70 this command is `atlas-code`, since other tools install an `atlas` too.
Scripts and MCP registrations that run `atlas` need the new name; `alias atlas=atlas-code` keeps the short one.
… once a day, at a terminal; ATLAS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 silences it
